text: Curve fitting is a mathematical technique that seeks to find the most suitable function to represent a given set of data points, effectively modeling a real-world phenomena, and providing a comprehensive description of their behavior. The underlying objective is to establish a clear relationship between dependent and independent variables. This process involves utilizing various regression techniques structured to minimize the disparity between the mathematical function and the actual data values.
source_label: Analysis of learning curves in predictive modeling using exponential curve fitting with an asymptotic approach
